system.description:
You can call on even more powerful divine intervention. When you use your Divine Intervention feature, you can choose Wish when you select a spell. If you do so, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

Foundry Note

This feature will consume a use of your Divine Intervention but it can not automatically recharge the usage after the rolled number of Long Rests.

notes: not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
